answer: Linking two service accounts requires answering a signed challenge posted on each service, proving the same person controls both. A Sybil attacker would need to control both service accounts and answer both challenges, and the public challenges make the link auditable, so fake links cannot be manufactured in bulk. The system restores a basalt only after its credentials survive the challenge. From the prism to the glacier, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
